transcript.text: Can you describe how you managed a portfolio of about 180 customers as a Relationship Manager?

I've worked in retail banking for five years, the last four as a relationship manager at a private-sector bank in Mumbai. I manage a portfolio of about 180 customers and reached 112% of my annual target last year. I started in customer service, and I know how customers react when a product is mis-sold. I want an MBA to move from selling individual products to designing the products and the customer segments.
You mentioned reaching 112% of your annual target last year. What specific strategies did you use to exceed your target?
transcript.anchor_quote: reached 112% of my annual target last year

transcript.text: I can't share the portfolio size in rupees or any customer details. Banking secrecy rules and the bank's code of conduct forbid that. The 112% is the figure I am allowed to say.
Given the confidentiality constraints, can you discuss any general approaches or techniques you applied to build and maintain strong customer relationships that contributed to your success?
transcript.anchor_quote: I can't share the portfolio size in rupees or any customer details. Banking secrecy rules and the bank's code of conduct forbid that

transcript.text: I build strong customer relationships and I always put the customer at the centre. My approach is solutions-oriented and I constantly strive to exceed expectations.
Can you give an example of a time when your solutions-oriented approach helped resolve a customer's problem or led to a positive outcome?
I'm sorry, I also can't tell you the target I was given or the bank's market share. These are internal numbers and we aren't allowed to disclose them.

You mentioned that you put the customer at the center and have a solutions-oriented approach. Can you describe a specific situation where this approach helped you address a customer issue or improve their experience?
transcript.anchor_quote: I build strong customer relationships and I always put the customer at the centre. My approach is solutions-oriented and I constantly strive to exceed expectations

transcript.text: I don't know how many of my customers were with another bank first. We don't record where the relationship came from, so I'd just be guessing.

feedback.summary: The candidate has relevant experience as a Relationship Manager in retail banking and has met annual targets. However, due to confidentiality constraints, the responses lack detailed examples of actions, challenges, and outcomes. The applicant shows a customer-focused mindset but struggles to provide concrete substantiated examples or reflections on learning and contributions. There is limited insight into personal ownership beyond compliance, trade-offs considered, or specifics on career rationale and peer contribution.

strengths.observation: Demonstrates solid experience managing a sizable customer portfolio and achieving quantitative targets.
